finalText:
Migration's done. 12 files, 36 call sites, all switched from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })` — apiKeyAdmin, session, teamService, cohort, refund, couponService, variantAdmin, supplier, shipment, returnService, macroAdmin, sla.

One holdout left on purpose: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` still calls `db.query` twice. Its header says it's a vendored copy, replaced wholesale on every upgrade, and local edits get silently lost — so I left it alone rather than have the fix vanish next sync. Worth handling upstream or with a wrapper if it needs covering.
